sources.title: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Policies: SmolVLA, Pi0, Pi0.5, GR00T, XVLA
sources.snippet: This page covers the implementation of large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies within LeRobot. These models bridge high-level natural language instructions and visual observations with low-level robotic control, often utilizing Flow Matching or Autoregressive token prediction for action generation.
